findings.finding: Price scope is unknown and prices are incomplete; the evidence does not establish an all-in party total.
Cabin is not uniform across the pool: reported journeys include economy and business. Separate-ticket examples also have economy and business variants on matching schedules.
These single-award examples have traveler support recorded as passed; this does not establish traveler support for separate-ticket choices.

Separate-ticket examples have traveler count and minimum-award-seat assessments unknown; positioning permission and separate-ticket obligations, including missed-connection protection, remain unverified.
Dated award availability, schedules, connectivity, feasibility, and bookability are unverified; the prepared evidence is not confirmation that a journey can be booked.
